said: Hi Q. I'm Nem, the founder of Kiln Payroll. We build payroll and tax compliance software for small and medium businesses in Lagos, Nigeria.
We're at seed stage. We're raising one point five million US dollars on a SAFE, and we've committed about two hundred thousand so far.
We have three hundred and twenty paying businesses, about twelve million naira in monthly recurring revenue, growing roughly fifteen percent month on month.
There are three of us. I was a product lead at Paystack for four years. My co-founder Tola is our CTO and previously built payroll systems at Flutterwave. Ada runs sales.
Our website is kilnpayroll dot com. We're based in Lagos and we started in 2024.
Yes, that's right. What else do you need from me?
